build_system: Vite for the frontend (npm run build = vite build). Backend is plain node (npm start = node server.js); no bundler, no build step. Two separate git repos: root repo ignores backend/, backend/ has its own .git.
test_framework: None. No unit test framework in either package.json. The required verification gate is the frontend production build.

verification_instructions: 1) Run `npm run build` in the repo root and confirm it exits 0 with no build-breaking errors. 2) For backend changes run `node --check backend/models/ProVCComment.js backend/routes/provcComments.js backend/server.js` (all exit 0) and `node -e "require('./backend/routes/provcComments')"` (loads without throwing). 3) Grep is NOT verification. Runtime endpoint testing needs a running backend + MongoDB (MONGO_URI) which may not be available in this sandbox; the build + syntax/require checks are the gate. 4) Confirm no existing dashboard feature was removed (Submissions tab, HOD Status tab, Summary PDF, approve/reject, Analyse expand, signature upload).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Frontend build outputs to dist/ (gitignored). No generated source files are checked in. Nothing to regenerate.

IMPORTANT git layout: the root git repo (branch master) has `backend/` in its .gitignore, so backend files are NOT tracked by the root repo — backend/ is a SEPARATE nested git repo (backend/.git, branch master tracking origin/master). Commit backend changes with `git -C backend add <files> && git -C backend commit` and frontend changes with `git add <files> && git commit` in the root. NEVER run `git add .` / `git add -A`: the `.agents/` directory is NOT gitignored and would be swept into commits; also the worktree already has pre-existing uncommitted modifications to src/pages/VCDashboard.jsx, src/pages/SubmissionDetail.jsx and backend server.js/package.json — stage ONLY the specific files each feature modifies. Build on the current on-disk state (read files before editing; do not revert existing WIP). Do not push.
contribution_requirements: React + Tailwind CSS only — do NOT add new libraries (recharts, axios, lucide-react, react-hot-toast are already deps and must be reused). Reuse existing components/APIs wherever possible. Comments must be saved to and loaded from MongoDB only — no hardcoded or dummy data. Preserve ALL existing dashboard features and functionality. Fix any errors before finishing.
key_patterns: Frontend HTTP: a shared axios client is exported from src/api.js (default export `api` with a JWT request-interceptor + correct baseURL; also sets axios.defaults.baseURL). Some pages instead use `const api = axios.create({ headers: { Authorization: \`Bearer ${token}\` } })` which inherits the global baseURL — either pattern works; prefer importing `api` from '../api' in new components. Toasts via `react-hot-toast` (toast.success/toast.error). Right-side overlays use createPortal(..., document.body) — see src/components/CommentEditor.jsx. Charts use recharts BarChart/Bar/XAxis/YAxis/Tooltip/ResponsiveContainer/Cell/ReferenceLine; bars are per-bar <Cell fill>. Auth on backend routes: `const { authMiddleware, requireAnyRole } = require('./middleware');` then `router.get('/:id', authMiddleware, requireAnyRole('vc','provc','admin'), async (req,res)=>{...})`. Models are plain mongoose.Schema + mongoose.model. CSS utility classes .card/.section-title/.table-header/.scrollbar-thin are defined in src/index.css and used in SubmissionDetail.jsx.
